findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/spec-review-round.ts::--mark-ratified trusts the skill that every objection of the round was ratified
findings.title: --mark-ratified trusts the skill that every objection of the round was ratified
findings.action: Keep: the spec places the every-objection check in the ratify procedure; the verb refuses autonomous runs, needs a comment id, a loop round and a recorded fix-and-rerun or park decision.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec §4.1 and P26 assign the every-objection judgement to the human-present ratify procedure; the verb enforces the mechanical preconditions.

occurrences.title: --mark-ratified trusts the skill that every objection of the round was ratified

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/spec-review-round.ts::--mark-ratified grants a cap exemption on an unverified claim; --open-window trusts an editable decision sidecar
findings.title: --mark-ratified grants a cap exemption on an unverified claim; --open-window trusts an editable decision sidecar
findings.action: --mark-ratified is now refused when the run ledger (--run-dir or $FAFF_RUN_DIR) says L3 or L4, so an autonomous run cannot claim interactive mode; test ratify refused autonomous.
findings.disposition_rationale: The mode flag was caller-supplied; the ledger level now gates it. The CLI makes no tracker calls by design, so comment existence stays with the skill's audited re-attach. --open-window reads a verb-written sidecar inside the same scratch-dir trust boundary as every round record; accepted.

occurrences.title: --mark-ratified grants a cap exemption on an unverified claim; --open-window trusts an editable decision sidecar

findings.title: no lock on the scratch dir; concurrent round calls could clobber records
findings.action: Keep: one prep owns an issue's scratch dir at a time (build claim and in-flight marker), exactly as the replaced prose assumed.
findings.disposition_rationale: Prep is the single writer per issue; the hold store is locked because resume-store stash is a second writer, which the scratch dir does not have.
